chunks: And ʿAlī عليه السلام, when he performed the funeral prayer over a man and a woman, he would place the woman in front and the man behind. And when he performed the prayer over a slave and a free person, he would place the slave in front and the free person behind. And when he performed the prayer over an elder and a child, he would place the child in front and the elder behind.

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the male deceased being prayed over
key_terms.الْحُرِّ: the free person in the funeral arrangement
key_terms.الْعَبْدِ: the enslaved person in the funeral arrangement
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةَ: the female deceased being placed in front

ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام arrange the deceased in salat al-janazah when praying over a man and woman, a slave and free person, or an elder and child together?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام in arranging bodies for salat al-janazah when praying over two deceased individuals together. It serves as a jurisprudential indication for the ordering of the deceased in funeral prayer according to category and status.
